purpose: Two concept review sheets, not inputs for a merged multi-object GLB

prompts.buildings: Create ONE polished art-direction contact sheet for a children's 3D electrical-construction game, six separate toy-town buildings arranged in a generous 3-column by 2-row grid on a warm ivory background. Use the supplied miniature city picture solely as the palette/style reference. Each building is an isolated complete three-quarter product render seen from the same elevated front angle, visible whole roof and base, no ground terrain, no street, no people, no surrounding props. High quality sculpted toy architecture with chunky rounded edges, softly painted wood/plastic, readable big forms, realistic soft contact shadow, clean ambient light, restrained tactile detail. The buildings must be visually distinct even at small size. TOP LEFT: grandmother's charming three-storey butter-yellow townhouse with teal roof, clearly three levels, a single open balcony on the right side of the upper floor, unobstructed vertical space below that balcony for an external lift, entrance at ground level, no external stairs. Balcony geometry is provisional concept only. TOP MIDDLE: one-storey warm cream bakery with coral roof and striped teal-and-cream awning, large recessed shop window with a few oversized golden bread shapes, small oven arch visible inside an open side alcove, no flames. TOP RIGHT: inviting two-storey teal school with muted navy roof, a large round clock above the entrance and a friendly arched doorway, no lettering. BOTTOM LEFT: compact coral-red fire station, one very large garage opening, cream trim and small red beacon on the roof, no vehicle. BOTTOM MIDDLE: lavender toy shop with amber roof, big display window with simple oversized toy-block and teddy silhouettes, no written sign. BOTTOM RIGHT: cheerful pale-mint community club/cinema with curved peach entrance canopy, a simple blank inset poster panel and a large sculpted star emblem, no text. Subdued cohesive palette coral, butter yellow, sea teal, periwinkle, slate blue. Large smooth masses and a few strong details suitable for mobile-game 3D conversion, no tiny clutter, no thin rails, no complex plants, no noisy texture, no glossy photorealistic glass, no captions or watermark. Important: this is a single concept sheet for design review, NOT a game map or a single merged model.
prompts.characters: Create ONE high quality art-direction contact sheet of six isolated friendly toy figures for a children's 3D electrical-construction game, arranged in a 3-column by 2-row grid with generous spacing on warm ivory. The supplied city illustration is only the palette and playful miniature-world reference; this sheet contains characters only, no buildings or setting. Same elevated three-quarter front angle for every figure, every figure fully visible including feet/paws, no shared pedestal. Beautiful softly sculpted collectible toys, rounded simple forms, soft painted plastic, clean warm studio lighting, matte-to-satin finish, expressive but restrained faces, small dark oval eyes with tiny catchlights. Cozy, kind, not uncanny. Human heads about one-third body height; stout legs and hands distinct from the torso, small gaps at armpits for readable silhouette. TOP LEFT: kind grandmother, silver hair in a tidy bun, simple glasses, warm lavender cardigan over teal dress, coral shoes, upright standing, no handbag or cane crossing the body. TOP MIDDLE: cheerful baker with short brown hair, plump white baker hat, cream shirt, coral apron and slate trousers, empty hands relaxed apart from torso, no bread attached. TOP RIGHT: smiling child with dark bobbed hair, mustard shirt, teal dungarees and pale coral shoes, standing balanced. BOTTOM LEFT: smiling child with curly brown hair, mint shirt, coral dungarees and navy shoes; same body proportions and broad neutral pose as the first child so they can share animation later. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a friendly plump raccoon on all four legs, anatomically clear four separate legs/paws, rounded muzzle, charcoal mask, soft gray body, thick striped tail held behind and clear of legs, mouth closed, no clothing, stylized like a wooden toy animal. BOTTOM RIGHT: small round gray-blue pigeon with subtly lavender neck, cream chest, short orange feet, folded wings, no detailed individual feathers. Consistent palette and style across all six, suitable for lightweight mobile 3D models. No gradients painted as fake facial reflections, no thin separate accessories, no tiny fabric patterns, no photorealism, no captions, no text, no watermark. A single concept review sheet, not six game-ready assets.
